title: Collector sidecar with schema adaptor for inference KPIs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: introduce a lightweight collector sidecar and a pluggable schema adaptor that normalizes and emits inference-specific KPIs (per-request latency breakdowns, token counts, batching metadata, model variant tags) to both OTLP and Prometheus endpoints with deterministic low-cardinality labels. This ticket implements the adaptor logic and the sidecar deployment pattern, plus presampling/shaping to keep cardinality and ingestion costs predictable. The adaptor must: map heterogeneous runtime labels to a canonical KPI schema, collapse high-cardinality user/model identifiers into stable buckets, compute derived metrics (e.g., tokens_per_second, kv_cache_hit_ratio), and add trace/span correlation fields for downstream queryability.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar deployed as a DaemonSet/sidecar in staging inference pods and successfully exports OTLP metrics to telemetry-ingest and Prometheus-compatible metrics to the scraping endpoint
Schema adaptor normalizes at least 10 runtime label variants into the canonical KPI labels with unit tests covering edge cases
End-to-end integration shows <5% increase in p95 ingestion latency and <10% CPU overhead on small GPU inference nodes
Cardinality reduction: canonical labels reduce unique metric series for the top-5 endpoints by >=35% compared to raw labels
Sampling/shaper enforces enforced QPS caps for high-volume routes and documents preserved sampling fraction per-route
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (spec + PoC, 2w): define canonical KPI schema and adaptor rules; build sidecar that accepts OTLP/Prometheus metric input and emits transformed OTLP; unit tests
Phase 2 (staging rollout, 2w): deploy sidecar to staging with presampling enabled on top-traffic routes; integrate with existing telemetry gateway and validate Prometheus scrape compatibility
Phase 3 (canary prod rollout, 1w): progressively enable on a single model class with canary dashboards; enable fallback to legacy path on degradation
Phase 4 (full rollout + telemetry tuning, 1w): tune sampling fractions and label bucketing thresholds; add observability dashboard and alerting for ingestion anomalies
riskiest_assumptions: Sidecar CPU overhead remains within budget on smallest supported node types
Label bucketing will not excessively degrade the usefulness of per-customer troubleshooting signals
Telemetry gateway accepts transformed OTLP without schema compatibility issues
testing_plan: Unit tests for adaptor rules and label normalization
Integration tests that replay production-like metric payloads and measure series cardinality and ingestion throughput
Load tests to quantify CPU/memory overhead and p95 latency impact on a representative node
Tracing correlation tests: ensure sidecar attaches trace_id and span_id to derived metrics and that dashboards can join traces to metrics
